newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends up, hedge selling trims gain.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends up, hedge selling trims gain.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Dec (3rd pos) 1,175 rgt/tonne Sept (south) 1,190
Open/Hi/low 1,165/1,185/1,165 Prev close 1,185
Prev settlement 1,163 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices were firmer on talk of smaller rise in September output over August. Hedge selling emerged and prices fell from day's high of 1,185 (Dec futures). Prices rose earlier on technical buying and covering after Dec breached support of 1,180. Trading remained volatile.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Prices held relatively steady with players waiting for more demand news.
However, liquidation and hedge-selling brought prices down to the day's low of 1,165 ringgit.
"We feel the market was toppish for the day at 1,185. That's why the selling came in," the dealer added.
Traders expect prices to consolidate at around current levels unless fresh developments appeared.
"We are waiting for some fresh tenders from India's STC and Pakistan and there was still no sign of them yet," one said.
By the close, December futures closed 12 ringgit up at 1,175 ringgit ($468.69) a tonne.
Traders pegged immediate resistance for December at 1,185 ringgit with strong support seen at 1,165.
Volume on the futures market was 2,965 lots against 2,229 on Wednesday. Physical prices held relatively steady with interest confining to selected products and nearby crude palm oil.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,190 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,195 to 1,190. Bids were at 1,180.
Oct (central) was offered at 1,170 with bids at 1,160 and Oct (north) at 1,160 against 1,145.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,195 ringgit with bids at 1,185. Nov (central) saw offers at 1,185 and bids at 1,175 and Dec (south) at 1,195 with bids at 1,185.
In refined palm oil market, RBD palm oil was offered at $510 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Nov/Dec at $507.50.
Oct palm olein saw offers at $545, Nov/Dec at $535 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $537.50. Oct was traded at $542.50 and Nov/Dec at $532.50.
Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $402.50 and Nov/Dec at $407.50. Oct/Nov palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $335.
